FIELDS.NAME: Radiant Glow Cosmetics
FIELDS.MAILING ADDRESS: 1234 Beauty Lane, Suite 100, Los Angeles, CA 90001-1234
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Radiant Glow Cosmetics operates as a retail-only business specializing in pre-packaged, branded cosmetics and toiletries. Our primary focus is on sourcing high-quality products exclusively from FDA-registered manufacturers to ensure safety and compliance with regulatory standards. With annual sales under $500,000, we maintain a low exposure to large-scale claims. Our operations are conducted from a single physical retail location without any invasive beauty treatments or product applications, further limiting our professional liability. We also have established robust inventory tracking and recall procedures to effectively manage any product issues that may arise. Our commitment to quality is demonstrated through a documented supplier vetting process and clear vendor agreements requiring product liability insurance from our suppliers.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2023, a shipment of cosmetics was damaged during transit due to a logistical error, resulting in a loss of $5,000. The claim is currently under review.

FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Radiant Glow Cosmetics does not own or operate any other business; our focus is solely on our retail operations.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Radiant Glow Cosmetics does not have any other insurance policies with this company apart from the current policy listed. Our operations are focused solely on retailing pre-packaged, branded cosmetics without additional insurance needs.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Radiant Glow Cosmetics does not engage in any manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products, as we solely focus on retailing pre-packaged, branded cosmetics sourced from FDA-registered manufacturers.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Radiant Glow Cosmetics does not rent or loan equipment to others, as our operations focus solely on retailing pre-packaged, branded cosmetics without engaging in any equipment rental activities.

FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Radiant Glow Cosmetics does not have any catastrophe exposure, as our retail operations focus solely on selling pre-packaged cosmetics without any on-site manufacturing or high-risk activities.
